# Repository instructions

The canonical instructions for this repository are in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read that file and follow it
in full: it covers build and test commands, CUDA review rules, benchmark
integrity, agent and security rules, and documentation expectations.

It is kept in one place so GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and any other agent
work from the same rules rather than three copies that drift apart.
